home.description.message: Meteor connects Java services to gRPC, Dubbo, Thrift, JSON-RPC, and other protocols, with service discovery and support for clients in many languages.

home.hero.description.message: Publish and call services through familiar Java interfaces. Use protocol plugins to connect clients across languages and ecosystems.

home.architecture.title.message: Services, gateway, and governance in one place

home.architecture.summary.message: One entry point for distributed services. Java applications and local services can both take part in RPC calls.

home.architecture.diagram.label.message: Meteor target architecture. Service C in Go calls the gateway, which forwards the request across languages to service A in Java. Cluster nodes can also call one another directly. Java services can publish directly, and Python, Go, and Node.js services can use Sidecar. The gateway has read-only access to service discovery, and Meteor Console provides service governance.

home.architecture.app.description.message: Integrate Meteor in Java applications and publish services over multiple protocols.

home.architecture.registry.description.message: Register and discover services published by applications and Sidecar.

home.architecture.console.description.message: Find services, debug calls, and manage governance rules.

home.examples.echo.message: Publish Echo and call it through its Java interface

home.participation.description.message: Share your experience, report issues, and help improve Meteor.

home.hero.illustration.message: Python and Node.js clients call services published by the Java application over gRPC and JSON-RPC, respectively. The Java application calls Go and Python services over gRPC and Thrift, respectively. More languages and protocols are available in both directions.
